resort_official.report_text:
November 24, 2026 | 3:51 PM

If you were out today, you know the skiing and riding was great. Chalky snow could be found in spots, with groomers offering top-to-bottom turns across the mountain.

With the current snowpack looking promising, Mountain Operations is anticipating additional terrain expansion as conditions allow.

For more details on what could be opening next, check out our latest Operations Blog.

See you out there!

-Dom

noaa_nws.synoptic_discussion:
* Outside of a few light showers in northeast California tonight into Wednesday, the forecast is dry and warmer, with favorable travel conditions for Thanksgiving.

* Pockets of freezing fog remain possible in the Martis Valley, Sierra Valley, and Mono Lake Basin overnight the morning hours the next several mornings.

* Rain and high elevation mountain snow return Sunday into Monday, with a stronger and colder storm possible Tuesday into Wednesday bringing the return of travel difficulties in the Sierra.

Issued 2026-11-24 21:48 UTC

discussions.text:
* Outside of a few light showers in northeast California tonight into Wednesday, the forecast is dry and warmer, with favorable travel conditions for Thanksgiving.

* Pockets of freezing fog remain possible in the Martis Valley, Sierra Valley, and Mono Lake Basin overnight the morning hours the next several mornings.

* Rain and high elevation mountain snow return Sunday into Monday, with a stronger and colder storm possible Tuesday into Wednesday bringing the return of travel difficulties in the Sierra.

Issued 2026-11-24 21:48 UTC

- Next weather system gradually moves into the region later this afternoon and evening bringing rain, a dusting of high elevation mountain snow, and breezy southeast winds into Wednesday morning

- Much of the rain will be overnight tonight and west of I-5.

- Return to dry weather by Wednesday afternoon, seasonable weather with additional Valley fog chances Thanksgiving Day into the early weekend

- Flood Warning remains in effect through 4 PM Thursday for coastal flooding and erosion potential for the Delta vicinity

- Active pattern expected to return late weekend into early next week

Issued 2026-11-24 21:11 UTC
